sources.entry: SaneClip - Clipboard manager with Touch ID protection, AES-256-GCM encryption, and sensitive data detection.

summary.one_liner: SaneClip is a privacy-focused macOS clipboard manager with optional encrypted history, Touch ID lock, and sensitive-data detection, plus a free iPhone/iPad companion app.
keywords: keep passwords out of clipboard history
summary.what_it_does: SaneClip records text, images, and screenshots copied on a Mac into a searchable, pinnable history with source-app attribution and source-based color coding. Pro features include AES-256-GCM history encryption, a Touch ID history lock with a 30-second grace period, unlimited history, snippets with placeholders, text transforms, and a FIFO/LIFO paste stack. Clipboard rules can automatically strip URL tracking parameters, trim whitespace, and normalize line endings on every copy. Sensitive-data detection flags credit cards (Luhn-checked), SSNs, API keys, passwords, private keys, and email addresses, with optional auto-purge. The app is controlled through saneclip:// URLs and App Intents/Shortcuts actions, and it offers macOS widgets for recent and pinned clips. Optional iCloud sync uses the user's own iCloud account, and an iOS companion app is listed as free.
use_cases: keep a searchable history of everything copied on a Mac
stop passwords and API keys from sitting in clipboard history
lock clipboard history behind Touch ID
paste snippets or templates with placeholders
sync clipboard history between Mac and iPhone through iCloud
automate clipboard actions with Shortcuts or URL schemes
how_to_run: git clone https://github.com/sane-apps/SaneClip (repository URL is blank in the README; git clone is shown without a URL)
notable: Encrypts history at rest with AES-256-GCM and stores protection keys in the macOS Keychain
Sensitive-data detection for credit cards, SSNs, API keys, passwords, and private keys
Two distribution channels: direct download with auto-paste and Sparkle updates, or Mac App Store with copy-only behavior
Clipboard rules and text transforms applied to copies and pastes
Free 14-day Pro trial, then one-time $14.99 purchase; also available in a $49.99 five-app bundle
caveats: Requires macOS 14.0 or later and an Apple Silicon Mac (M1+) for the macOS app.
Core Pro features (encryption, Touch ID lock, unlimited history, OCR capture) require a paid Pro unlock after the 14-day trial.
The Mac App Store version cannot auto-paste; it copies to the clipboard and the user must press Cmd+V.
Licensed under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0, which is source-available and not an OSI open-source license; it forbids building a competing product.
